## Description

Implement the relationship + purpose parts of the authorisation hooks from P0: a clinician has a care relationship when the patient has an appointment/encounter with them, is in their facility's active patient list (configurable clinic policy), or access was granted. Purpose is recorded with every read. Request-access workflow for clinics; hospitals' break-glass comes in P7.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] **AC1.** Clinicians without relationship get 403 + "Request access" (audited); owners can grant time-limited access.
- [ ] **AC2.** Every clinical read records purpose (treatment, registration, billing, audit).
- [ ] **AC3.** Clinic policy "all facility clinicians" vs "assigned only" is configurable and tested.
- [ ] **AC4.** Nurse access is limited per the matrix (Limited on Patient 360; entry of vitals/allergies).

## Definition of Done

All acceptance criteria above, **plus** the cross-cutting X1–X8 checklist in [docs/05-delivery](../../docs/05-delivery/README.md#definition-of-done-every-ticket).
